caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a piece of textile, possibly a garment or cloth fragment, centrally positioned on a plain background. The textile is rendered in shades of grey, with detailed line work and shading that create a textured appearance. The textile has an irregular, somewhat rectangular shape with extensions at the bottom and sides, and features intricate, repeated floral patterns across its surface. The top edge is decorated with a border that resembles lace or embroidery, with zig-zag or scalloped edges. The center and lower part of the textile include dense stippling and more concentrated pattern work, with one larger circular floral motif located towards the bottom middle extension. The right side of the drawing contains the name "Herbert Marsh" written neatly in small letters. The overall drawing is monochromatic, relying on the pencil or graphite’s varying tones to convey detail and texture.
title: Embroidered Yoke
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
